newsitem.title: USA: New York timecharter fixtures - Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: New York timecharter fixtures - Sept 17.

text.p: Lowlands Jade (built 1992) 149,383 dwt del Dunkirk early Oct via Hampton Roads-Richards Bay redel Japan $15,000 daily Navix.
Georgios (built 1982) 148,581 dwt del Cont. end Sept. via Brazil redel Far East $12,000 daily Keoyang.
Energy Phoenix (built 1994) 68,636 dwt del Ecaussie 1-5/10 redel Japan $7,250 daily plus $90,000 bb Daiichi.
Vitali (built 1982) 62,390 dwt del USG 1-10/10 redel Far East $9,650 daily plus $95,000 bb Pan Ocean.
